abyss_pair_conformance.reason: The isolated Python MCP 2.0.0 KAG pair passed discovery, stateless, auth, limits and read behavior; SSE disconnect cancellation reached the server dispatch and the cancelled operation did not complete afterward.

compatibility_aliases.reason: The stable aoa_kag and isolated aoa_kag_next_lab names are distinct; the lab contour was removed without touching the stable registration.

dual_support.reason: The stable modern lab pair used a separate process, endpoint, credential, registration and CODEX_HOME; operator config remained byte-identical and the stable route passed after rollback.

official_conformance.reason: Official conformance commit c321dd3 freezes requirements per specification revision; Python MCP 2.0.0 passed every scored client and server check for 2026-07-28, while later extension and pending failures remain visible and unscored.

read_only_canary.reason: The separately registered aoa_kag_next_lab performed exact discovery and kag_discover through stable Codex 0.147.0 on the 2026-07-28 wire.

rollback.reason: The lab app-server and MCP process stopped, port closed, registration and credential were removed, stable config stayed byte-identical, and the existing aoa_kag registration passed a real post-rollback canary.

tasks_extension.reason: Tasks remains a separate extension gate; Python MCP 2.0.0 does not implement it and stable Codex 0.147.0 did not advertise io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks on the real modern request wire.
